---
title: "Parasite Age Distributions by Sequestered Biomass"
output: github_document
---

This analysis compares posterior latent parasite age distributions across quartiles of estimated raw sequestered biomass in AQUAMAT. Sequestered biomass is calculated from plasma PfHRP2 and peripheral parasitaemia using the published Hendriksen formulation, with a sensitivity analysis excluding zero PfHRP2 measurements.

Posterior parasite age distributions are reconstructed from the saved hierarchical Stan models, including unimodal and bimodal patients. Each patient contributes one distribution, while estimated sequestered biomass is summarised across 20 imputations. The inferred parasite age distributions are conditional on the fixed sequestration assumptions used in the hierarchical staging model.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(data.table)
library(rstan)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

options(scipen = 999)
```

```{r paths, include = FALSE}
# Locate the repository root
ROOT <- file.path("..", "..")

MODEL_DIR <- file.path(ROOT, "Staging", "Imputed", "outputs")

RDS_DIR <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, "RDS")
CSV_DIR <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, "CSV")

UNIMODAL_FIT_FILE <- file.path(RDS_DIR, "fit_hierarchical_unimodal.rds")
BIMODAL_FIT_FILE <- file.path(RDS_DIR, "fit_hierarchical_bimodal.rds")
UNIMODAL_SUMMARY_FILE <- file.path(RDS_DIR, "hierarchical_unimodal_patient_summary.rds")
BIMODAL_SUMMARY_FILE <- file.path(RDS_DIR, "hierarchical_bimodal_component_summary.rds")
HIERARCHICAL_FILE <- file.path(CSV_DIR, "dat_all_hierarchical.csv")
```

```{r definitions, include = FALSE}
# ---- Definitions ----
# Student-t degrees of freedom used by the staging model
DF_T <- 10

# Parasite stage boundaries across the 48-hour cycle
aa <- c(0, 6, 16, 26, 30, 34, 38, 48)

stage_names <- c("Tiny rings", "Small rings", "Large rings", "Early trophozoites",
                 "Mid trophozoites", "Late trophozoites", "Schizonts")

# Use 250 posterior draws to reconstruct each patient's age distribution
N_POSTERIOR_DRAWS <- 250L

# Evaluate parasite density in 0.1-hour bins across the 48-hour cycle
AGE_STEP <- 0.1
age_grid <- seq(0, 48 - AGE_STEP, by = AGE_STEP)
N_AGE <- length(age_grid)
```

```{r cohort, include = FALSE}
# ---- MI cohort and exact Stan patient ordering ----
# One patient-level copy of the final MI hierarchical cohort
dat_hierarchical <- fread(HIERARCHICAL_FILE)

dat_all <- copy(dat_hierarchical[.imp == min(.imp)])

# Preserve the patient order used for the final plotting dataset
dat_all[, plot_row := .I]

# Recover the exact patient ordering associated with the saved Stan fits
unimodal_summary <- as.data.table(readRDS(UNIMODAL_SUMMARY_FILE))
bimodal_summary <- as.data.table(readRDS(BIMODAL_SUMMARY_FILE))

unimodal_ids <- as.character(unimodal_summary$ID)
bimodal_ids <- as.character(bimodal_summary$ID)

N_UNIMODAL <- length(unimodal_ids)
N_BIMODAL <- length(bimodal_ids)
N_PATIENTS <- nrow(dat_all)

cat("Total patients: ", N_PATIENTS, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Unimodal patients: ", N_UNIMODAL, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Bimodal patients: ", N_BIMODAL, "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r helpers, include = FALSE}
# ---- Density functions ----
# Select evenly spaced posterior draws
select_draws <- function(n, target) {
  if (target >= n) {
    return(seq_len(n))
  }
  unique(as.integer(round(seq(1, n, length.out = target))))
}

# Calculate wrapped Student-t density across the 48-hour parasite cycle
wrapped_t_density <- function(age, mu, sigma) {
  density <- numeric(length(age))

  for (m in -1:1) {
    density <- density + dt((age + m*48 - mu) / sigma, df = DF_T) / sigma
  }
  density
}

# Normalise each patient's parasite age density to 100%
normalise_grid <- function(x) {
  total <- sum(x)
  100 * x / total
}
```

```{r unimodal, include = FALSE}
# ---- Unimodal posterior reconstruction ----
fit_unimodal <- readRDS(UNIMODAL_FIT_FILE)
post_u <- rstan::extract(fit_unimodal, pars = c("mu_age", "sigma_age"))
draw_u <- select_draws(nrow(post_u$mu_age), N_POSTERIOR_DRAWS)
latent_u <- matrix(0, nrow = N_UNIMODAL, ncol = N_AGE)

for (d in draw_u) {
  for (i in seq_len(N_UNIMODAL)) {

    latent_u[i, ] <- latent_u[i, ] + wrapped_t_density(age = age_grid,
                                                       mu = post_u$mu_age[d, i],
                                                       sigma = post_u$sigma_age[d, i])
  }
}

# Average the wrapped parasite age density across posterior draws
latent_u <- latent_u / length(draw_u)

# Normalise the posterior mean latent density for each patient
latent_u <- t(apply(latent_u, 1, normalise_grid))

rm(fit_unimodal, post_u)
gc()
```

```{r bimodal, include = FALSE}
# ---- Bimodal posterior reconstruction ----
fit_bimodal <- readRDS(BIMODAL_FIT_FILE)

post_b <- rstan::extract(fit_bimodal,
                         pars = c("mu_age_1_mod48", "mu_age_2_mod48", "sigma_age_1",
                                  "sigma_age_2", "weight1"))

draw_b <- select_draws(nrow(post_b$mu_age_1_mod48), N_POSTERIOR_DRAWS)
latent_b <- matrix(0, nrow = N_BIMODAL, ncol = N_AGE)

# Reconstruct both parasite age components for each posterior draw
for (d in draw_b) {
  for (i in seq_len(N_BIMODAL)) {

    p1 <- wrapped_t_density(age = age_grid, mu = post_b$mu_age_1_mod48[d, i],
                            sigma = post_b$sigma_age_1[d, i])

    p2 <- wrapped_t_density(age = age_grid, mu = post_b$mu_age_2_mod48[d, i],
                            sigma = post_b$sigma_age_2[d, i])

    # Combine components using the posterior mixture weight
    w1 <- post_b$weight1[d, i]
    latent_b[i, ] <- latent_b[i, ] + w1*p1 + (1 - w1)*p2
  }
}

# Average and normalise the latent density for each patient
latent_b <- latent_b / length(draw_b)
latent_b <- t(apply(latent_b, 1, normalise_grid))

rm(fit_bimodal, post_b)
gc()
```

```{r combine, include = FALSE}
# ---- Combine latent distributions by patient ID ----
latent_u_dt <- data.table(ID = unimodal_ids)
latent_u_dt <- cbind(latent_u_dt, as.data.table(latent_u))

latent_b_dt <- data.table(ID = bimodal_ids)
latent_b_dt <- cbind(latent_b_dt, as.data.table(latent_b))

latent_all <- rbindlist(list(latent_u_dt, latent_b_dt), use.names = TRUE)

# Attach the reconstructed distributions to the final MI cohort by ID
latent_all <- merge(dat_all[, .(plot_row, ID, trial)],
                    latent_all, by = "ID", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

# Restore the patient order from dat_all_hierarchical.csv
setorder(latent_all, plot_row)

latent_matrix <- as.matrix(latent_all[, -c("ID", "trial", "plot_row")])
```

```{r biomass-order, include = FALSE}
# ---- Calculate raw sequestered biomass for AQUAMAT patients ----
obs <- fread(file = file.path(ROOT, "Data", "dat_all.csv"))
imp <- fread(file = file.path(ROOT, "Data", "Imputed_dataset_long.csv"))

obs <- obs[Trial == "AQUAMAT" &
           is.finite(hrp2_plasma) & hrp2_plasma >= 0,
           .(ID = as.character(ID), hrp2_plasma)]

imp[, ID := as.character(ID)]
imp <- imp[.imp %in% 1:20]

biomass_data <- merge(imp, obs, by = "ID")

if ("trial" %in% names(biomass_data)) {
  biomass_data <- biomass_data[trial == "AQUAMAT"]
}

# Keep patients with valid measurements in all 20 imputations
biomass_data <- biomass_data[is.finite(hct) & hct > 0 & hct < 100 &
                               is.finite(parasitaemia) & parasitaemia > 0]

complete_ids <- biomass_data[, .(n_imp = uniqueN(.imp)), by = ID][n_imp == 20L, ID]
biomass_data <- biomass_data[ID %in% complete_ids]

# Calculate circulating biomass once for each imputation
biomass_data[, circulating_per_kg := 80000 * parasitaemia]

# Use the published Hendriksen biomass coefficient
BIOMASS_K <- 7.3e7

# Retain only patients with reconstructed AQUAMAT distributions
aq_ids <- as.character(dat_all[trial == "AQUAMAT", ID])
biomass_data <- biomass_data[ID %in% aq_ids]
```

```{r biomass-quartiles, include = FALSE}
# ---- Compare posterior parasite age distributions across biomass quartiles ----
# Match posterior distributions to patient identifiers
latent_dt <- data.table(ID = as.character(dat_all$ID),trial = as.character(dat_all$trial))
latent_dt <- cbind(latent_dt, as.data.table(latent_matrix))
latent_dt <- latent_dt[trial == "AQUAMAT"]

density_cols <- setdiff(names(latent_dt), c("ID", "trial"))

# Use four shades of AQUAMAT red
quartile_colours <- c("Q1 (lowest)" = "#F2A0A4", "Q2" = "#E8757C", "Q3" = "#C9343D",
                      "Q4 (highest)" = "#891C26")

# Store aggregate results from both PfHRP2 selections
quartile_summaries <- list()
quartile_curves_all <- list()

# Calculate raw sequestered biomass using Hendriksen
coefficient <- "Hendriksen"
d <- copy(biomass_data)

d[, total_per_kg := BIOMASS_K * hrp2_plasma * (1 - hct / 100)]
d[, sequestered_raw_per_kg := total_per_kg - circulating_per_kg]

for (selection in c("Nonnegative", "Positive_only")) {
  if (selection == "Positive_only") {
    z <- d[hrp2_plasma > 0]
  } else {
    z <- d
  }

  # Summarise biomass across imputations for each patient
  patient_groups <- z[, .(sequestered_raw = median(sequestered_raw_per_kg)), by = ID]

  # Match patients to their posterior parasite age distributions
  patient_groups <- merge(patient_groups, latent_dt, by = "ID")

  # Order patients by increasing raw sequestered biomass
  setorder(patient_groups, sequestered_raw, ID)

  # Assign four consecutive quartiles of approximately equal size
  patient_groups[, quartile := factor(ceiling(4 * seq_len(.N) / .N), levels = 1:4,
                                      labels = names(quartile_colours))]

  # Confirm that biomass increases across quartiles
  check <- patient_groups[, .(median_biomass = median(sequestered_raw)), by = quartile]
  stopifnot(all(diff(check$median_biomass) >= 0))

  # Summarise patient numbers and biomass ranges
  summary_dt <- patient_groups[, .(patients = .N, min_biomass = min(sequestered_raw),
                                   median_biomass = median(sequestered_raw),
                                   max_biomass = max(sequestered_raw)), by = quartile]

  summary_dt[, `:=`(coefficient = coefficient, selection = selection)]
  quartile_summaries[[length(quartile_summaries) + 1L]] <- summary_dt

  # Average posterior parasite age density within each quartile
  curve_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(levels(patient_groups$quartile), function(q) {
    subset_dt <- patient_groups[quartile == q]
    density_matrix <- as.matrix(subset_dt[, ..density_cols])

    data.table(quartile = q, parasite_age = age_grid,
                mean_density = colMeans(density_matrix))}))

  curve_dt[, `:=`(coefficient = coefficient, selection = selection)]

  quartile_curves_all[[length(quartile_curves_all) + 1L]] <- curve_dt
}

# Combine the aggregate results
quartile_summary <- rbindlist(quartile_summaries)
quartile_curves <- rbindlist(quartile_curves_all)

print(quartile_summary)
```

```{r quartile-plots, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis', fig.width = 11, fig.height = 6.5}
# ---- Generate figures for both PfHRP2 selections ----
# Plot parasite age distributions across biomass quartiles
for (selection_name in c("Nonnegative", "Positive_only")) {
  plot_data <- quartile_curves[selection == selection_name]

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = parasite_age, y = mean_density, colour = quartile)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(6, 16, 26, 30, 34, 38), linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = quartile_colours) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 48), breaks = c(0, 6, 16, 26, 30, 34, 38, 48),
                       expand = c(0, 0),
                       sec.axis = dup_axis(breaks = c(3, 11, 21, 28, 32, 36, 43),
                                           labels = c("Tiny rings", "Small rings",
                                                      "Large rings", "Early", "Mid", 
                                                      "Late", "Schizonts"), name = NULL)) +
    labs(x = "Parasite age (h)", y = "Mean parasite density (% per 0.1 h)",
         colour = "Sequestered biomass quartile") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
    theme(plot.title = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(b = 6)),
          legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 13), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(10, 12, 10, 12))

  if (selection_name == "Nonnegative") {
    plot_label <- "Nonnegative PfHRP2"
  } else {
    plot_label <- "Positive PfHRP2 only"
  }

  cat("\n\n### ", plot_label, "\n\n", sep = "")
    
  print(p)
}
```
